case.pattern_description: Coordinated online fraud ring operating through a specific device (D004630) behind an anonymous proxy across multiple cardholders. The perpetrator conducts low-value online transactions using newly added card numbers to systematically stay below automated scoring thresholds. This multi-card syndicated modus operandi matches four earlier confirmed fraud cases on this device classified as undocumented.

evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3468363 was performed using device D004630, a specific profile marked New to this account and operating behind an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS).

Device D004630 connects card C12796-K1 to 11 other cards active in the past 30 days (C01996-K2, C04108-K2, C10326-K1, C10193-K2, C01289-K1, C02975-K1, C13487-K1, C02910-K1, C09975-K1, C08168-K1, C11670-K2), all appearing as new devices behind a proxy for low-dollar online charges.
Device D004630 was confirmed fraudulent in four earlier closed cases (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, CC-3035) involving unauthorized online purchases behind an anonymous proxy classified as undocumented.
The bank's second-generation fraud model scored transaction 3468363 at 0.007 with a historical fraud rate of 0.006, and legacy risk score was 0.10.
Billing region 299 displays a low fraud lift of 0.41 relative to baseline, with 12 out of 1,401 transactions scoring >= 0.5, showing no localized geographic fraud cluster.
The purchase amount of $150.22 represents a standard retail amount rather than an extreme high-dollar outlay.

evidence.claim: Rule R9: Undocumented patterns: Rule R9: Undocumented patterns. When activity fits none of the known patterns but the evidence shows coordinated or repeated abuse across customers, recommend `CREATE_CASE`, `FILE_REPORT`, and `ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST`, and describe the pattern in your own words. Do not force it into a known category.

Rule R6: Shared origin: Rule R6: Shared origin. When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, the same billing region, or the same recipient email in one window, name the shared element, recommend `CREATE_CASE` and `FILE_REPORT`, and `MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS` for every card that shares it.

case.summary: Transaction 3468363 ($150.22) on card C12796-K1 was flagged by proactive ring monitoring due to the use of device D004630, associated with fraud ring 57672119. Although the model score was very low at 0.007, device D004630 operated behind an anonymous proxy, appeared as a new device on 11 other cards over the past 30 days, and was confirmed fraudulent in four prior closed cases. Because the strong syndicated cross-card links conflict with the low calibrated model score, the verdict remains uncertain with an assessed fraud probability of 0.17. The case was created, connected cards were placed on monitoring, and the matter was escalated to an analyst for further adjudication.
